pages.title: A Baby on the River
pages.content:
It is a sunny Saturday. Yusuf and Grandpa are at the river. They sit under a big tree. A small boat goes down the river. “Look, Grandpa! A boat!” Yusuf says. Grandpa smiles. “A long time ago, a baby goes down a river, too. His name is Moses. Do you want to hear his story?” “Yes, please!” Yusuf says.

“Moses lives in Egypt,” Grandpa says. “The king of Egypt is Pharaoh. He is not a kind king. He says, ‘I am your god.’ There is a group of people in Egypt. They love Allah. Pharaoh does not like them. He takes their baby boys. Moses’s mother has got a baby boy, too. She is afraid. Allah tells her, ‘Put him in a basket. Do not be afraid. We will bring him back to you.’ She puts the basket on the River Nile. She tells Moses’s sister, ‘Follow the basket!’”

vocabulary.definition: The man at the top of a country.
A box of thin wood or grass. You can carry things in it.

pages.title: Back to His Mother
pages.content:
Yusuf looks at the river. “Where does the basket go, Grandpa?” he asks.

“The water takes it to Pharaoh’s palace,” Grandpa says. “Pharaoh’s wife, Asiya, sees the baby. She is a good woman. She loves the baby. ‘Do not hurt him. He can be our son,’ she says. But the baby is hungry, and he doesn’t drink milk from any woman. Then Moses’s sister comes to the palace. She says, ‘I know a good woman.’ She brings her own mother! Now, baby Moses is with his mother again. She is very happy.”

vocabulary.definition: The very big house of a king.

pages.title: Two Sisters at the Well
pages.content:
“Does Moses live in the palace, Grandpa?” Yusuf asks.

“Yes, he does,” Grandpa says. “He is a big, strong man now. He always helps people. One day, Moses sees two men. One man is not kind. Moses wants to help the good man. He hits the bad man one time. The man falls down and dies. Moses does not want this! He is very sad and prays to Allah. But Pharaoh’s men want to catch him. So, he leaves Egypt. He walks for many days. He comes to a well. There are two sisters there with their sheep. They can’t give water to their sheep. Moses helps them. Their father is very happy. Later, one of the sisters is his wife. They live there for ten years.”

vocabulary.definition: He can carry heavy things.
Goes down to the ground.
A deep hole in the ground with water in it.

iCan: I can say: Moses helps the two sisters.

pages.title: A Fire on the Mountain
pages.content:
Yusuf throws a small stone into the river. “Then what happens?” he asks.

“Moses and his family go back to Egypt,” Grandpa says. “It is a cold, dark night. Moses sees a fire on a mountain. He goes up the mountain. There, he hears a voice: ‘O Moses, I am Allah.’ Moses has got a stick in his hand. Allah tells him, ‘Throw it down, O Moses.’ Moses throws his stick down. It is a big snake now! Moses is afraid. Then the snake is a stick again. Allah makes Moses His Messenger. He sends Moses to Pharaoh because Pharaoh is not fair and does not know Allah. Moses’s brother, Aaron, goes with him.”

vocabulary.definition: Something very hot, red and yellow.
A very high hill.
The sound of a person when they talk.
A long, thin piece of wood.
A person who brings Allah’s words to people.
Good and right for everybody.

pages.title: The Magicians
pages.content:
“Is Pharaoh angry?” Yusuf asks.

“Yes, he is,” Grandpa says. “Moses and Aaron go to the palace. Moses says, ‘I am a Messenger of Allah.’ Pharaoh does not listen to him. Pharaoh says, ‘Show me a sign!’ Moses puts his stick on the floor, and it is a big snake! Pharaoh thinks it is magic. He calls his magicians. The magicians say, ‘Watch us!’ The magicians put sticks on the floor. They look like snakes! Then Moses puts his stick on the floor. It is a very big snake. It eats all the magicians’ snakes! The magicians see it is real. They believe in Allah. But Pharaoh doesn’t believe. Now, Pharaoh is very angry with Moses and his people.”

vocabulary.definition: Tricks. They are not real.

iCan: I can say: The magicians believe in Allah.

pages.title: The Sea Opens
pages.content:
Yusuf holds Grandpa’s hand. “Is Moses safe, Grandpa?” he asks.

“One night, Moses and his people leave Egypt,” Grandpa says. “In the morning, they come to the sea. Pharaoh and his men are behind them! The people are very afraid. But Moses says, ‘My Lord is with me.’ Allah tells Moses, ‘Hit the sea with your stick.’ Moses hits the sea, and the sea opens! There is a road in the sea. Moses and his people walk to the other side. Then the water comes back over Pharaoh and his men.”

Yusuf smiles. “Allah always helps good people!” he says.

“Yes, Yusuf,” Grandpa says. “Allah is always with good people.” They walk home along the river.

vocabulary.definition: A very big area of salt water.

Moses helps two sisters at a well.
Moses hears a voice on the mountain.
Moses’s snake eats the magicians’ snakes.
Moses and his people walk through the sea.
